name: NVIDIA Quantum-X Photonics Q3450-LD co-packaged-optics InfiniBand switch (spine)
description: 4U liquid-cooled XDR InfiniBand switch with co-packaged silicon-photonics optics: 144 x 800 Gb/s on MPO connectors, 115.2 Tb/s, 18 removable light-source modules, 48 V DC busbar input, 4 x UQD4 liquid connections. No pluggable transceivers at the switch end; the far end still needs a transceiver. In production per press (June 2026).

hop_latency_ns.note: NVIDIA does not publish a port-to-port latency for Quantum-X800. Estimated from the previous-generation QM8700 HDR brief ('sub-130ns port-to-port latency', source nvidia-qm8700-brief) and an integrator blog claiming sub-100 ns for Quantum-X800 (introl-x800, unverified). Range widened upward because the 4U system is built from multiple Quantum-3 ASICs (the 2U Q3200 is '2 independent 28.8Tb/s switches') and the internal path is not published. Same Quantum-3 switching as Q3400; CPO does not change switching latency materially.

power_w.note: MAX with active cables, including the co-packaged optics; typical not published

liquid_fraction.note: liquid-cooled (4 x UQD4) with residual fan air (2 replaceable fans per NVIDIA intro); split not published
